claim: Onboarding OB-6, sign-up hand-off, AuthContext and lib half (founder /goal 2026-11-07, every fork the session's call; proposal p4-scratch/sw-walk/onboarding/proposal.md §3 OB-6). AuthContext.registerAccount keeps the gateway's verificationMail in sessionStorage 'mudavym:verification-mail' (noteSignUpMail; every read and write in try/catch), without editing Register.tsx (open PR #691 owns it). AuthContext.endSession, which every sign-out and refused refresh runs, clears the key (clearSignUpMail), so a not_sent note never reaches the next person on a shared tab (audit 2026-11-07). The web VerificationMail type and resendOutcome know 'unconfirmed', an outcome the page does not know is read as 'unconfirmed' and never as sent, and 'unconfirmed' is worded 'Sending is taking longer than usual. The email may still arrive; ...'. What /verify-email says from the key is the next PR's row, OB-6-SIGN-UP-MAIL-REACHES-VERIFY-EMAIL (split out 2026-11-07 to keep each PR under 30K of diff). Behavioural proof: apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.signUpMail.test.tsx (incl. 'forgets the note at sign-out') and apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.test.ts, which fail against origin/fix/verify-mail-carries-a-code's web files.
verify: grep -qF "export type VerificationMail = 'sent' | 'not_sent' | 'unconfirmed'" apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.ts && grep -qF "export const VERIFICATION_MAIL_KEY = 'mudavym:verification-mail'" apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.ts && grep -qF "return isVerificationMail(said) ? said : 'unconfirmed'" apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.ts && grep -qF "if (outcome === 'unconfirmed') return UNCONFIRMED_SENTENCE" apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.ts && grep -qF 'noteSignUpMail(response.data?.verificationMail)' apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx && grep -qF 'clearSignUpMail();' apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx && test -f apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.test.ts && test -f apps/web/src/contexts/AuthContext.signUpMail.test.tsx
